meta.name: Universal Monsters
meta.description:
Blood-sucking vampires, stitched-together monsters, and howling werewolves are guaranteed to give you goosebumps!

Shows: Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein, Abbott and Costello Meet the Invisible Man, Abbott and Costello Meet the Killer, Boris Karloff, Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy, The Andromeda Strain
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus
